name: Personalized Wooden Tissue Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality 5mm wood for a sturdy, durable, and long-lasting structure.
    - Features a multi-panel construction that creates a stable and functional tissue box.
    - Smooth wooden surfaces provide a clean base for detailed personalized printing.
    - Precision-cut slots and joints help the panels fit together securely.
    - Includes custom decorative pieces that add a layered, dimensional appearance.
    - Designed with a removable or opening lid for convenient tissue replacement.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall box size:
                            +) Width: 5.2 in ~ 13.21 cm
                            +) Height: 5.2 in ~ 13.21 cm
                            +) Depth: 4 in ~ 10.16 cm
    - Internal opening size: 4.77 x 3.61 in ~ 12.12 x 9.17 cm
    - Minimum size for each separate custom piece: 2 cm
    - Supports up to 5 separate decorative pieces.
    📌 Note: The shape of the box is fixed and cannot be changed. The dimensions of the wooden piece on top of the box may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Features double-sided printing on the wooden panels and decorative pieces.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed to hold and cover a standard tissue box while adding a decorative personalized touch.
    - The top opening allows tissues to be pulled out easily during everyday use.
    - Opening lid makes it convenient to insert, remove, or replace the tissue box.
    - Suitable for use in living rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, offices, classrooms, and reception areas.
    - Helps conceal plain commercial tissue packaging for a cleaner and more coordinated display.
    - Can be personalized to match holiday themes, room décor, family designs, or special events.
    - Layered custom pieces create a dimensional and eye-catching appearance.
    - Works as both a practical tissue holder and a decorative tabletop accessory.
    - Reusable wooden construction makes it suitable for year-round or seasonal display.
    - Compact structure can be placed on desks, counters, nightstands, shelves, and side tables.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for Christmas, birthdays, housewarmings, and holidays.
    - Great for family members, friends, coworkers, teachers, and office staff.
    - Suitable for personalized home décor gifts featuring names, photos, or custom artwork.
    - A charming option for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, anniversaries, and wedding gifts.
    - Ideal for festive gift baskets, seasonal decorations, and holiday home accessories.
    - A practical keepsake that combines everyday function with personalized decorative value.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 - 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Wooden Tissue Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1 - 0.3  cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
